title: Consumers Prioritize Value in Store Purchases
discussion_signal: ICSC's relay says consumers remain active in stores and continue making discretionary purchases, but are becoming more selective, deal-conscious, and intentional as prices remain high. It frames value as broader than low price and links the finding to its Consumer Economy Report. This reinforces the atlas distinction between spending levels and household flexibility without proving real consumption growth or welfare improvement.
linked_research_question: When consumers keep spending but become more selective, which forms of value preserve demand and which households are already at the edge of discretionary room?
limits: The post is an industry relay and does not provide respondent-level data
Continued spending does not establish real volume, affordability, or household welfare
The post does not isolate price, quality, trust, convenience, or income effects
